svg.title: Party deployment configurations I
svg.desc: One validated diagram for each general deployment pattern used by the Core Scenarios: fixed long/short edges, roll-off choice of edge or corner, and corner zones.
svg.text: Each party deploys within 6" of its own
long battlefield edge (6" is the 10.1 step 7
default where the scenario gives no
Each party deploys within 6" of its own
short battlefield edge (6" is the 10.1 step 7
default where the scenario gives no
(1) The Setup Roll-off winner chooses the
edge (a long edge, or any battlefield edge,
as the scenario states; the 10.1 step 7
default where it is silent). (2) The other

also the 10.1 step 7 default). (2) The other

alternate placing Heroes within their zone,
starting with the party that lost the Setup
Zones and bands are drawn to scale on a 36"×36" battlefield (4 pt per inch); Hero markers are enlarged. North and South are the short
edges and East and West the long edges, even on a square battlefield (10.1). Each party may field 1–4 Heroes; two or three are shown.
Where a scenario states no depth or zone size (Sun-Drowned 2 and 3, The Mire 3, 5 and 6), the 10.1 step 7 default applies: 6" from the
edge, 8"×8" corners. Where it states no placing order (these, Pale City 1 and most edge scenarios), Heroes are placed alternately from
the Roll-off loser. Where only "opposite battlefield edges" are named, the Roll-off winner chooses the edge.
